_comment: Prices per million tokens, USD. Unknown price is null: the report then shows a dash instead of an invented number. access describes how the run was paid for: free (free tier), paid, local (own hardware), unknown.
_why_open_models_have_a_price: A model served on a free tier is not a free model. The open weights behind it have a public market price, so cost per score is computable from the measured tokens. price_ref names the exact OpenRouter listing the rate was taken from, so every number here can be re-checked against a source instead of trusted.
_where_to_look_up_a_rate: 1. OpenRouter first — https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models is one request, needs no key, and returns prompt/completion prices per token for every listed model. Multiply by 1e6 for the per-Mtok fields used here. This is the fastest route and covers nearly every open-weight model.
2. The model card next — the Hugging Face page or the vendor's release post, when OpenRouter has no listing or lists several sizes under one codename.
3. The vendor's own price page last — required for closed models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), which OpenRouter does not always mirror at the official rate.
Always record price_ref and price_date. A rate without its source cannot be re-checked, and prices move.
Never fill in a rate to make a chart look complete: null renders as a dash, which is the truthful answer.
_local_runs: Local models run on the user's own hardware, so a dollar price would be electricity, not a tariff. Their cost stays null and they are compared by tokens and time only.
_unmapped: pickle-rick-free and x-preview-f-free are stealth codenames with no published identity. Guessing which open model sits behind them would produce an authoritative-looking cost that is simply invented, so they stay unpriced until the vendor names them.

opencode/mimo-free.price_note: OpenRouter lists xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 (0.14/0.28) and xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro (0.435/0.87); the codename does not say which one is served, and the two differ threefold

claude/claude-opus-5.price_note: not needed: the claude CLI reports total_cost_usd per run, and a measured cost beats a tariff estimate

codex/gpt-5.6-terra.price_note: the codex CLI reports tokens but no cost, so this rate has to be filled in by hand from the vendor price list
